thread:
Mira: Quick heads-up, I'll be at DevCon Fri evening -> Sun evening and need oncall coverage for Sat + Sun. I can do Fri night but need someone to pick up Sat (UTC day) and/or Sun. There's a planned rollout Sat 22:00 UTC (low risk) that I'd like someone to watch. Anyone able to swap or take a day? :raised_hands:

Alex K: I can take Sunday, in that timezone and available all day. Will follow the handoff checklist.

Tony: I can cover Saturday. I'm online Sat afternoon already, happy to own 20:00-02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Mira: Thanks both. Tony = primary Sat for the rollout watch, Alex = primary Sun.

Sam: Can you paste quick handoff notes for the rollout (what to watch, who to ping) so backup can triage if noise shows up? Also any expected downstream impact? I can be backup.

Mira: Handoff notes below (copying into thread):
- Rollout: model-serv v2.3 -> canary 5% at 22:00 UTC Sat, 50% at 22:30, 100% at 23:00. Rollback: manual via deploy-bot if error rate > 1% sustained over 5m.
- Watch: latency P95, 5xx error rate, token throughput. Expect transient KV-cache warm spikes first ~10m.
- Quick commands: 
```
# check canary status
kubectl -n inference get deploy model-serv -o yaml | grep -A3 "canary"
# metrics: open Grafana dashboard
https://grafana.example/d/model-serv-overview
# rollback
deploy-bot rollback model-serv v2.2
```
- Who to ping: @infra-oncall for infra issues, @model-team for regressions, ping Mira for context. If paging thresholds hit, escalate to oncall lead.
- Downtime: none planned; if >2% error rate hold and rollback.

Alex K: Added those commands to my runbook. Quick Q: any dataset migrations? I heard about a KV tidy job at 18:00.

Mira: KV tidy finishes by 19:00 UTC; that's before rollout and actually helps warm caches. Main risk = cold-start latency for long prompts.

Julia: FYI I'll be on a customer call Sun 10:00-12:00 UTC but reachable for pages. If things get noisy ping me and I can jump in.

oncall-bot: Mira added OOO: 2025-06-13T18:00Z -> 2025-06-15T22:00Z

Sam: With Tony + Alex + Julia as backups this looks covered. Tony, can you post a short Sat morning ack so we know handoff landed? :eyes:

Tony: Will do. Ack by 09:00 UTC Sat and a pre-rollout check at 21:30. Enjoy DevCon! :party:

Mira: Thanks all. I'll keep phone on for urgent pages but otherwise offline. Appreciate the coverage. :heart:
